nodes.label: Dependency-Free Date Components
nodes.rationale: Ship DateField, Calendar, and DatePicker with shared internal date infrastructure and no added runtime dependency.

nodes.label: DateField
nodes.rationale: Public locale-aware segmented entry preserves ISO values, accessible Field linkage, local partial drafts, and native form participation.

nodes.label: Calendar
nodes.rationale: Public standalone fixed-grid calendar owns selection and keyboard navigation but leaves overlay closing to DatePicker.

nodes.label: DatePicker
nodes.rationale: Composes shared DateField and Calendar internals with the existing overlay system under one ISO source of truth.

nodes.label: Calendar engine
nodes.rationale: Kept internal to centralize strict parsing, epoch-day arithmetic, conversion, and grid generation without promising a general-purpose public arithmetic API.

nodes.label: Locale formatter
nodes.rationale: Internal formatting owns localized order, digits, literals, labels, direction, and accessible text while leaving ISO values unchanged.

nodes.label: Date draft reducer
nodes.rationale: Keeps partial entry, typeahead, paste, reconciliation, and commitment deterministic and local until a complete selectable date exists.

nodes.label: Calendar grid model
nodes.rationale: Internal pure model owns fixed-grid generation, focus, visible month, selection, and availability.

nodes.label: Popover
nodes.rationale: Reused to preserve the established overlay contract, Floating UI path, dismissal, containment, theme propagation, and focus return.

nodes.label: Button
nodes.rationale: Selectively reused for navigation, clear, and trigger controls while native buttons remain preferred for day cells.

nodes.label: SSR-safe locale external store
nodes.rationale: Uses deterministic en-US on the server and re-resolves the browser locale after hydration; explicit locale avoids client reformatting.

nodes.label: ISO Gregorian value contract
nodes.rationale: Every public, callback, and submitted value remains a strict padded YYYY-MM-DD Gregorian string from year 0001 through 9999 regardless of display calendar.

nodes.label: Calendar adapters
nodes.rationale: Synchronous bundled adapters cover Gregorian, Buddhist, Japanese, ROC, Persian, Islamic Civil, and Hebrew conversion and arithmetic across the full ISO range.

nodes.label: APG keyboard behavior
nodes.rationale: Calendar navigation uses day and week arrows, localized Home and End, calendar-month Page movement, year movement with Shift+Page, and Enter or Space activation.

nodes.label: Fixed 6x7 calendar grid
nodes.rationale: Always renders six rows by seven columns with adjacent-month cells and one roving grid tab stop.

nodes.label: initialFocusRef
nodes.rationale: Backward-compatible Popover.Content seam for placing initial focus on the selected or current calendar day.

nodes.label: VoiceOver and Safari validation
nodes.rationale: Manual heading, cell, blocked-date, and month-announcement validation is required when available because axe cannot substitute for platform-specific screen-reader behavior.

nodes.label: P0-P3 self-review loop
nodes.rationale: Each phase uses bounded review and focused verification, fixes all P0 and P1 plus practical P2 findings, and stops after three passes or repeated identical findings.

nodes.label: DateField and Calendar Quality Refactor
nodes.rationale: Resolve maintainability findings without public API, observable behavior, dependency, DOM, ARIA, form, locale, arithmetic, styling, or DatePicker integration changes.

nodes.label: dateFieldInteractions
nodes.rationale: Pure module owns segment movement, restoration, clearing, stepping, digit normalization, era typeahead, paste parsing, and draft resolution.

nodes.label: calendarInteractions
nodes.rationale: Pure module maps supported keys to calendar focus movement or activation while Calendar keeps state and rendering ownership.

nodes.label: Immutable gridKey
nodes.rationale: Epoch-derived keys replace index-derived React keys for every calendar cell, including cells outside the supported ISO range.

nodes.label: ReadonlySet fixed-month calendars
nodes.rationale: Replaces the fixed-month calendar array with an immutable set while preserving calendar behavior.

nodes.label: P0-P3 self-review loop
nodes.rationale: Each phase performs at most three severity-graded passes and fixes all P0, P1, and practical P2 findings.

nodes.label: Public API and behavior preservation
nodes.rationale: The refactor must retain public contracts, DOM and ARIA semantics, keyboard interaction, form values, locale behavior, arithmetic, styling, and integration.

nodes.label: CI Parity Installation

nodes.label: Agent Self-Review Loop
nodes.rationale: Severity-based review with a three-pass cap prevents unresolved high-impact findings and endless no-op iteration.
